title: Meta-Analysis: A Practical and Modern Guide with R
description: An open textbook on systematic reviews and meta-analysis with runnable R code: effect sizes, common- and random-effects models, heterogeneity and meta-regression, dependent effects, publication bias, sensitivity analysis, Bayesian, network, MASEM, multivariate, IPD, diagnostic accuracy, causal estimates, and GRADE. Online edition: https://mikenguyen13.github.io/meta_analysis/
